WITH patient_level AS (
  SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, 
         AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) as avg_alb_minus_tp,
         AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) as avg_appt_minus_pt
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_level AS (
  SELECT SEX,
         AVG(avg_alb_minus_tp) as avg_alb_minus_tp_by_sex,
         AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt) as avg_appt_minus_pt_by_sex
  FROM patient_level
  GROUP BY SEX
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt_by_sex) as mean_val
  FROM sex_level
),
above_threshold AS (
  SELECT avg_alb_minus_tp_by_sex, avg_appt_minus_pt_by_sex
  FROM sex_level
  WHERE avg_appt_minus_pt_by_sex > (SELECT mean_val FROM threshold)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_alb_minus_tp_by_sex) as final_avg_alb_minus_tp,
  AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt_by_sex) as final_avg_appt_minus_pt,
  AVG(avg_appt_minus_pt_by_sex) - (SELECT mean_val FROM threshold) as excess_over_mean
FROM above_threshold
